name: Kaitlyn's Awakening
source:
In this game you play as Kaitlyn in the United States, led by your friendly friends. The world is ravaged and rebuilt after Kaitlyn was brought to life with a mission... or was she? Will the U.S. become the last nation of freedom?! Play through up-to five new levels from New York City during WWII against Nazi America.

[from [url=https://4th-dimension-studio.itch.io/kaitlyns-awakening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏中，你将在亲切朋友的引导下，扮演身处美国的凯特琳。凯特琳被赋予使命、获得生命后，世界遭到摧毁，又被重建…真是这样吗？美国会成为自由最后的国度吗？！从二战时期的纽约出发，挑战最多五个新关卡，对抗纳粹美国。

[摘自[url=https://4th-dimension-studio.itch.io/kaitlyns-awakening]itch.io[/url]]
